These results advance ARPA-E’s mission by enabling non-flammable, low-cost storage for renewable integration and resilient grids. 2. Accomplishments and Objectives Technical objectives were to deliver a rechargeable Zn-pulp battery with: (i) –50 °C to 80 °C operating range, (ii) ≥1000 cycles, (iii) ≥80 Wh kg⁻¹ specific energy, and (iv) ≤$30/kWh projected cost. A comparison of planned milestones versus achieved outcomes is summarized below.
